title: Digit Sum
prompt: Implement `digit_sum(n)`: sum of the decimal digits of a non-negative integer. Use `% 10` and `/ 10` in a while loop.

tests.name: multi digit
tests.hint: 1+2+3+4 = 10: peel digits with n % 10, then n /= 10.

tests.name: zero
tests.hint: 0 has digit sum 0 — loop must not run.
